notes: This is general information, not a decision on whether you qualify. Final eligibility is decided by the government office or portal that runs each scheme.
Schemes change. Always confirm the latest rules and documents on the official portal, at a Common Service Centre (CSC) or with your state labour department before applying.
Only facts that were checked against the listed source are shown as verified. Anything marked 'not verified' must be confirmed by you.

schemes.name: e-Shram registration (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
schemes.summary: A free, one-time registration for unorganised workers, including gig and platform workers. Being registered is the first step to being considered for several social security and welfare schemes.
eligibility: Is not an income tax payer and is not a member of EPFO or ESIC
documents: Mobile number, preferably linked to Aadhaar
benefits: Access to a one-stop solution that brings together 15 social security and welfare schemes, including PM-SYM, PMSBY and PMJJBY
schemes.how_to_apply: Register for free on the e-Shram portal, at a Common Service Centre (CSC), or at a State Seva Kendra. Registration is free; you do not need to pay any agent.
schemes.source_title: Government of India, Press Information Bureau document, 25 Aug 2026

schemes.name: PMSBY: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (accident insurance)
schemes.summary: Accident insurance for accidental death or disability.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or permanent disability
schemes.how_to_apply: Listed among the schemes reachable through e-Shram. Ask your bank or a CSC how to enrol.
schemes.source_title: Government of India, Press Information Bureau document, 25 Aug 2026
unverified_notes: Age limit, yearly premium and enrolment steps were not verified. Confirm with your bank or a CSC.
No verified application link is available in this app.

schemes.name: PMJJBY: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (life insurance)
schemes.summary: Life insurance that pays the family if the insured person dies.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for death from any cause
schemes.how_to_apply: Listed among the schemes reachable through e-Shram. Ask your bank or a CSC how to enrol.
schemes.source_title: Government of India, Press Information Bureau document, 25 Aug 2026
unverified_notes: Age limit, yearly premium and enrolment steps were not verified. Confirm with your bank or a CSC.
No verified application link is available in this app.

schemes.name: PM-SYM: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (pension for unorganised workers)
schemes.summary: A pension scheme for unorganised workers.
benefits: Minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month at age 60, subject to eligibility
schemes.how_to_apply: Listed among the schemes reachable through e-Shram. Ask a CSC how to enrol.
schemes.source_title: Government of India, Press Information Bureau document, 25 Aug 2026
unverified_notes: Entry age limits, income limit and monthly contribution were not verified. Confirm before applying.
No verified application link is available in this app.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY health cover for gig and platform workers
schemes.summary: The Government of India announced health cover under PM-JAY for gig and platform workers in Budget 2025-26. Platform workers are asked to register on e-Shram first. This applies if you work through an app-based platform.
benefits: PM-JAY provides up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment at empanelled hospitals
schemes.how_to_apply: Self-register on the e-Shram portal first, so you can be considered for the benefit.
schemes.source_title: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Press Information Bureau release
unverified_notes: The source said the scheme was 'soon launching'. Whether it is now active for gig workers, and the exact eligibility rules and documents, were not verified.
Check on the e-Shram portal or ask a CSC before relying on this cover.

schemes.name: State gig-worker welfare laws (Karnataka, Telangana)
schemes.summary: Some states have introduced laws for registration, social security and welfare of platform-based gig workers. Karnataka has had a Platform Based Gig Workers (Social Security and Welfare) Bill, 2025. The Telangana assembly was reported to have passed a gig workers bill in 2026.
schemes.how_to_apply: Ask the state labour department how registration works.
schemes.source_title: PRS Legislative Research, Karnataka Platform Based Gig Workers Bill 2025
unverified_notes: Only the existence of these bills was checked. Whether each law is now in force, who can register, the benefits and the documents were not verified.
Other states may also have gig-worker laws that are not listed here.
